Call for Nominations: 27th Dr PRJ Gangadharam Award
Thursday, 20 August 2026
420 Hits
The Kasturba Health Society and Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (MGIMS), Sewagram, Wardha, is pleased to announce the call for nomination for 27th Dr. PRJ Gangadharam Award for outstanding contributions in the field of Tuberculosis. This award seeks to honor an individual who has made significant, sustained, and original contributions in the field of tuberculosis (TB), with demonstrable impact on TB prevention, diagnosis, treatment, care, or control.
About the Award:  Late Dr. Pattisapu Rama Jogi Gangadharam was Professor of Medicine, Microbiology and Pharmacology, Directorate of Mycobacteriology Research at the University of Illinois College of Medicine, Chicago, USA. The journey of almost 50 years of his career was full of contributions, achievements, recognitions and awards in the field of Tuberculosis. He was also very closely associated with the Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, India’s first rural medical college, which also had Tuberculosis as one of its thrust areas of research.
This is the 27th Dr Pattisapu Rama Jogi Gangadharam Endowment Oration Award. The award consists of a citation, to & fro travel and a sum of ₹50,000. The component of oration is mandatory and  has been kept so that the recipient of the award can share his/her experience with the audience.
The  previous  recipients  of  this  award  have  been Dr C V Ramakrishnan, Dr S Radhakrishnan,  Dr Sushila  Nayar,  Dr A K Chakraborty, Dr  P  Jagota, Dr G R Khatri, Dr M L Mehrotra, Dr M M Singh, Dr C N Parmasivan, Dr L S Chauhan, Dr R Narayanan, Dr V M Katoch, Dr  Prahlad Kumar, Dr. V. K. Chadha, Dr N Selvakumar, Dr D Behera, Dr Soumya Swaminathan,  Dr R Sarin, Dr Sunil D Khaparde,  Dr K K Chopra,  Dr Madhukar Pai, Dr Anurag Bhargava, Dr Padmapriyadarsini, Dr V,K.Arora and Dr Urvashi Singh.
The details for submitting the nomination of the candidate are attached as PDF as well as in Poster form. The nominations based on the eligibility criteria mentioned in the attached document can be sent to the address given in the form, either by post /e-mail or in the Google form provided.
I solicit your help in forwarding and disseminating this information to all the  Departments of your institute and to those who are actively involved in TB work and research and who may be in a position to nominate an eligible individual  for the award.
The last date for submitting the nomination is 15th October 2026.
